description: Lists the servers and Kubernetes clusters in the signed-in Opservo workspace, with each one's agent_id, kind (linux server or kubernetes cluster), hostname, display name and whether it is online. Archived servers are left out.
name: list_agents

add_server_url.description: Present only when the workspace has no server yet: the page that shows their one-line install command.

agents.description: Servers and clusters in the workspace, most recently seen first.

agent_id.description: Server id (UUID) used by every per-server tool.

log_health.description: Latest log-summary health: healthy, degraded, critical or unknown.

name.description: Display name set in Opservo, when it differs from the hostname.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

next_step.description: Present only when the workspace has no server yet: what to tell the user so they can add one.

title: List servers
